summary: @servicetitan/cp-ui preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub release archive into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. If a system-installed `bun` binary is already available it is used instead. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line bundle using string-array rotation and hex-named identifiers characteristic of obfuscator.io-style protection; it bears no relation to the package's advertised purpose (a React UI component library) and is not reachable through normal Node module resolution — only via the preinstall-invoked Bun runtime. Installing this package causes the obfuscated payload to execute automatically on the installer's machine under an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based tooling and review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
